title: System: storage, background jobs and workers
summary: KloudC masters: check where store files live, see background jobs that failed and retry them, and watch the workers.

blocks.text: Open **Platform settings** and look at **System**. It shows four things: **Storage**, **Background jobs**, **Workers** and **Live updates**. Tap **Refresh** to read them again.

items: **Waiting**: in the queue. **Running**: a worker has it.
**Retrying soon**: it failed and tries again by itself, waiting 30 seconds, then 1 minute, then longer.
**Failed**: it stopped after its last try. Read the error, fix the cause, then tap **Retry**. Every retry is in the audit log.
**Inline** means there is no queue: each job runs inside the web server, as before.
Each worker checks in every 15 seconds.
**Not responding** means no check in for 2 minutes. Its jobs are handed to another worker.
Workers are started on the server (see the multi-process deploy guide), never from this page.
**On this server** keeps files in each store's folder. **Object storage** keeps them in a bucket such as Cloudflare R2.
Access keys are never shown, only the bucket and its host.
**Live updates** across processes are needed only when more than one server process runs.
